title: Morphology and Body-Plan Contract
objective: Normalize size-independent anatomy, limbs/manipulators, worn regions, attachment points, natural appendages and unusual body plans so humanoid and non-humanoid species use one morphology interface and equipment compatibility can query body structure without species-name branching.
acceptance: humanoid and non-humanoid fixtures use one morphology interface
inventory/equipment can query body compatibility without species-name branching
boundaries: MVPS-03 owns morphology/body-plan contract semantics only.
Scale mechanics remain MVPS-04/shared scale-owner territory.
Equipment compatibility policy is refined in MVPS-07; MVPS-03 exposes queryable body structure only.
MVPS-04+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
next_action: Establish causal RED for one size-independent morphology interface shared by humanoid and non-humanoid fixtures, including body regions, limbs/manipulators, worn regions, attachment points and natural appendages, plus equipment-facing structural queries without species-name branching; then implement only MVPS-03 contract/fixture semantics.
